title: BioInteract: Interpretable Drug--Target Interaction Prediction via Residue-Level Cross-Attention with Biological Prior Knowledge
description: Final reproducibility-audit release for the BioInteract Davis-benchmark binary high-affinity interaction classifier. The release includes source code, frozen configuration files, archived checkpoints, canonical full-precision entity-split predictions and metrics, strict split artifacts, figure-generation scripts, and reproducibility manifests. It records the training provenance, early-stopping selections, paths, and SHA-256 digests for exact-sequence-grouped cold-target and cold-both checkpoints trained from initialization. Unsupported numerical cross-model baselines and their figure artifacts have been removed. It also provides the code, aggregate manifests, and closed pair-level curation audit for a prespecified strict BindingDB Kd-only exact-double-novel external evaluation performed with a frozen Davis checkpoint and threshold. That external result shows limited transfer and is not evidence for broad DTI generalisation, structural contacts, binding pockets, or mechanisms.
